test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
A standing committee is a committee consisting of members of which of the following houses of Parliament?

1.Rajya Sabha

2.Lok Sabha

3.Vidhan Sabha

options.text: Both Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **Standing Committee** is a permanent committee consisting of members from either or both Houses of Parliament — **Rajya Sabha** and **Lok Sabha**. 
 
• These committees are set up to deal with specific issues or perform detailed scrutiny of government policies, bills, or financial matters.
 
• **Membership**: Members are drawn from both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, depending on the committee's type and function.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types**: There are different types of Standing Committees, such as:
 
• **Departmental Standing Committees** (examining ministry-specific policies and bills).
 
• **Financial Committees** (Public Accounts Committee, Estimates Committee, etc.).
 
• **Other Standing Committees** (e.g., Committee on Privileges, Committee on Petitions).
 
• **Permanent in Nature**: Unlike ad hoc committees, these are permanent and reconstituted periodically.
 
• 
 
**Vidhan Sabha**: This is the State Legislative Assembly, not part of the Union Parliament, so its members do not form Standing Committees in the context of Parliament.
